title: microbudget-granulator and adaptive-quant-minimizer: tenant-aware cost smoothing
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Customers running multi-tenant workloads report noisy unit economics when small tenants intermittently spike, causing autoscaler thrash and suboptimal quantization choices. This PR implements a microbudget-granulator that smooths tenant-level cost profiles into stable budgeting curves and an adaptive-quant-minimizer that picks the least-aggressive quant tier that meets SLO-delivered quality metrics. The change reduces churn in batching and cache warmups while preserving tail latency. What changed: 1) runtime/prefill/granulator: new microbudget smoothing component that consumes tenant telemetry and emits short-term budget curves used by the batching scheduler. 2) runtime/quant/adaptive_minimizer: decision engine that ranks quant tiers based on simulated-loss impact and recent eval traces, with a safety net to revert if quality drift is detected. 3) admin/cli: add `rw econ profile --dryrun` to preview granulator output and quant recommendations per tenant. 4) telemetry: new metrics tenant.budget_curve.stability, quant.minimizer.rank_distribution, and alerts for quant rollback rate. Design notes: the granulator uses exponential smoothing with per-tenant alpha tuned from historical burstiness percentiles; budgeting windows default to 3m/15m/1h rollups. The quant-minimizer runs ensemble heuristics: a cheap static cost model, a light-weight loss proxy on sampled responses, and a safety evaluator that watches production evals before a recommended change is applied. Rollout plan: feature flag default-off; staged rollout to internal prod, then 10% of tenants for 48h, then full enablement. A/B experiment has been set up to validate unit-econ improvements and key quality metrics. Testing: added unit tests for smoothing math, integration tests for decision flow, and a small e2e against the batcher using a synthetic tenant workload. Related: ENG-1459 tracks follow-up to expose tenant tuning knobs in Console. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests - [x] Telemetry hooks - [x] CLI dry-run - [x] Docs snippet in cost-ops guide (short) - [x] Feature flag gated in main config
